facts.text: Sit down, stranger. The bookstore's closed, but the coffee pot isn't.
facts.why: Not found among Carolina's lines on the quote page ('No.', 'I know.', 'Where are you going?'). It is printed in quote marks as her words. In the film she tends his wounds in the bookstore, so a note about that would be true to her.
facts.fix: Sit down. The shop is closed, but the back room is not. Let me look at that hand.

facts.text: A home-cooked meal in Carolina's flat.
facts.why: Carolina treats El Mariachi in her bookstore-cafe and says she has an apartment upstairs. No home-cooked meal is shown.
facts.fix: from Carolina's flat above the bookshop

vibe.verdict: A moody Tarasco Bar menu with good Mexican food, but the Carolina note is invented and the film's best set pieces are barely used.

The bookstore burning and the rooftop escape
